text:
maria (finance): Heads-up: launching a concise billing change — unify promotional credit expiries to 10 months and introduce a $5 auto-grace for tiny Hosted overages. Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/promo-grace (internal)

deploy-bot: Broadcast scheduled for 2026-04-10T15:00:00Z to Hosted plans. Email template: billing/promo-grace-v1

noah (billing): Key points: promo_expires_iso will be emitted as a string on invoices; grace_flag: true/false. Auto-grace suppresses charges <= $5 for 72h, then converts to account credit if usage continues. Enterprise/dedicated excluded by default.

ari (eng): For eng: add parsing for promo_expires_iso in the billing UI and expose feature flag billing.promo_grace.enabled. No API-breaking changes planned.

zoe (support): Please add a one-pager for support replies. We get a lot of "where did my credit go" tickets.

maria (finance): Will drop a Support Playbook in #support-playbooks by EOD with canned responses and escalation steps.

sam (sales): Account teams: flag any customers with bespoke promo expiries in the "hold-promo-normalize" sheet. We'll skip normalization for those.

maria (finance): Rollout timeline: internal docs & playbook 2026-04-09 -> UI flags & feature gate 2026-04-11 -> normalize existing promos 2026-05-12. Thanks all! :tada:
